status: partial board contracts; no factory boot claims
notes: Each catalog ID has a distinct BoardModel name and an explicitly selected hardware target. Sharing protocol mechanics follows independent manufacturer mapping, not name similarity.
Only native authored Xtensa SRAM probes are verified for the three TFT variants. Pro has native protocol tests; no new variant has a complete factory or Meshtastic boot claim.
No CPU, bus, per-tick or shared peripheral changes; exact board pin routing and SPI card wiring are local.
All four physical TF slots use the platform prepared 64 MiB FAT32 card policy. Board tests use smaller deterministic images solely to verify real SPI block read/write.
Storefront publication dates are retained only as low-confidence ordering proxies, not advertised as hardware release dates.

items.name: LILYGO T-Deck Pro Meshtastic (V1.0)
items.hardwareRevision: T-Deck Pro V1.0 / HD-V1-250326; manufacturer-documented Meshtastic V1.0 target only

display.touchScope: CST328 single-contact report/ACK only; initialization identity registers are unmodeled
display.orientation: Native portrait controller RAM; storefront width/height are landscape presentation

sdCard.defaultImagePreparedBy: platform existing TF-card storage service; board only attaches supplied image
sdCard.supply: Fixed digital powered socket; PMIC supply sequencing is unmodeled

chronology.notes: Official Shopify published_at is a provisional listing-order proxy, not a confirmed hardware release. It can reflect republishing and software-preloaded editions; created_at is retained separately.

items.scope: 选定 Pro V1.0 / HD-V1-250326 的 Meshtastic 硬件目标；SPI 墨水屏 RAM、刷新和 BUSY、35 键矩阵、CST328 单点报告/ACK 与 SPI TF 卡已建模。V1.1/MAX、射频、定位、语音及 4G 未模拟，Meshtastic/出厂固件启动未验证。
items.scopeEn: Exact manufacturer-documented Meshtastic V1.0 target: UC8253 display, TCA8418 matrix, CST328 reports and SPI SD. V1.1/MAX, radio, GNSS, voice and cellular are excluded; factory and Meshtastic boot unverified.
unsupported: Monochrome digital RAM and command-triggered refresh only. E-paper LUTs, analog waveform drive, grayscale, temperature dependence and ghosting are unmodeled.
SPI-only transport is implemented; bit-banged software SPI and nine-bit SPI are not implemented.
Unknown display commands are ignored and counted. Unsupported panel-setting values cannot publish a frame.
No official factory image has been executed. Native protocol tests are not proof of a working complete factory firmware or physical device.
PMIC, battery state, charger, RF/LoRa, GNSS, IMU, RTC, ambient sensors, audio and vibration are unmodeled; their I2C addresses remain absent.
CST328 unknown firmware information/configuration reads NACK. The manufacturer factory probe requests 0xD1F4; that initialization path is deliberately not claimed as implemented.
Only 35 physical keys are accepted: rows 0-2 columns 0-9, row 3 columns 5-9. Uppercase factory legend codes for non-letter keys do not establish the printed physical key legend.
CST328 IRQ follows a digital pending-report latch inferred from the official read/ACK sequence; scan timing and multiple simultaneous contacts are unmodeled.
The storefront spans optional A7682E and PCM5102A variants and does not identify PCB revision. This profile explicitly selects manufacturer-documented V1.0; V1.1 and MAX are not interchangeable.
Audio part naming differs between storefront PCM5102A and repository PCM512A. Neither audio nor cellular is emulated; no substitution is inferred.

protocol.malformedWindows: reject without drawing or wrapping writes

timing.basis: UC8253 timings use official bundled GxEPD2 nominal constants; not measured hardware

keyboardMapping.note: Non-letter physical legends remain unverified; controls use row/column names instead of inventing arrows or function labels.

factoryFirmwareInvestigation.notes: Manufacturer README lists this Meshtastic firmware for V1.0. Directory/binary layout and factory identity have not been inspected; no default factory image is claimed.

variantEvidence.basis: Official Meshtastic storefront links T-Deck-Pro. Repository revision table explicitly selects V1.0/HD-V1-250326, and manufacturer-tested firmware table maps that V1.0 to firmware-t-deck-pro-2.7.10.94d4bdf.bin; V1.1 has a separate target.

items.name: LILYGO T-Deck Meshtastic
items.hardwareRevision: Original T-Deck SX1262-equipped ST7789/GT911 hardware; excludes T-Deck V2, Pro and no-LoRa SKUs

display.touchScope: GT911 0x5d single-contact status/report/ACK subset; no firmware calibration or alternative 0x14 address
display.orientation: Manufacturer landscape MADCTL=0x60; native controller RAM is 240x320

sdCard.defaultImagePreparedBy: platform existing TF-card storage service; board only attaches supplied image
sdCard.supply: GPIO10 digital peripheral rail; power/card removal resets the protocol without erasing supplied storage

items.scope: 选定原版 T-Deck 的 SX1262 版本；ST7789 显示、GT911 单点触摸、35 键 I²C 键盘、轨迹球、SX1262 数字寄存器子集及真实 SPI TF 卡已接入。原生 Xtensa 指令已验证显示写入和按键按下/释放；定位、音频、电池和完整 Meshtastic/出厂固件启动未验证。
items.scopeEn: Exact original T-Deck SX1262 SKU: routed SPI ST7789, GT911 0x5d touch, C3 keyboard protocol, trackball, digital SX1262 subset and SPI SD. Real native Xtensa MMIO probes verify screen writes and button press/release; factory/Meshtastic boot unverified.

variantEvidence.basis: Official product listing links T-Deck. Manufacturer LilyGoLib hardware document explicitly states original and Plus share the main GPIO mapping; firmware README labels the same factory image for both and documents the shared TFT Meshtastic target. Exact current pin header agrees.

unsupported: No official factory or Meshtastic binary for these selected catalog variants has been executed. Native authored SRAM probes verify only their stated peripheral contracts.
SX1262 model is a digital register/packet subset. RF propagation, antennas, RF filters, transmit power and an independent over-the-air network are unmodeled.
GT911 is one contact at address 0x5d; address strap 0x14, multiple contacts and touch-panel repair/calibration firmware are not modeled.
The keyboard models the manufacturer I2C protocol and 35 ms scan, not execution of the secondary ESP32-C3 CPU.
Backlight is modeled as routed steady on/off only; the physical 16-level pulse-coded brightness driver is not implemented.
GNSS, I2S microphone/speaker, battery ADC, charging, RF analog behavior and USB are unmodeled.
SPI SD requires the exact clock/MOSI/MISO/CS routes and exclusive chip selection. Only SPI controller transfers are implemented; software bit-banged SD is not.

keyboardMapping.note: Physical control layout maps into the documented C3 5x7 electrical matrix; holes are rejected.

factoryFirmwareInvestigation.notes: Manufacturer labels shared T-Deck/T-Deck-Plus factory target and TFT Meshtastic image. Exact bytes and merged/app layout have not been inspected; filename/size alone do not establish a bootable platform image.

grove.note: Plus uses these pins for onboard GNSS; original exposes Grove UART/I2C wiring but no attached peripheral is emulated.

chronology.notes: Official Shopify published_at is a provisional listing-order proxy, not a confirmed hardware release. It can reflect republishing and software-preloaded editions; created_at is retained separately.
